reviewerInstructions: It should be reworded to a seagull moves your ball

original.title: Ball moved by an animal
original.question: A dog runs onto the fairway and knocks your ball out of its spot. According to the rules, what should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new spot
Add a penalty and replace the ball

original.explanation: If an outside influence, such as an animal, moves your ball at rest, you must replace it without penalty.

suggestion.title: Ball moved by a seagull
suggestion.question: A seagull lands on the fairway and moves your ball from where it was. What should you do under the rules?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new position
Put the ball back where it was with no penalty
Add a penalty and put the ball back

suggestion.explanation: If an outside influence, like a seagull, moves your ball while it is at rest, you must put the ball back in its original place without penalty.
